_note: Live pricing is applied via the Apify API (pricingInfos). video-reencode-minute added 2026-10-28.

file-converted.title: File converted
file-converted.description: One successfully converted output file (primary event). Failed files are free.

media-minute.title: Media minute processed
media-minute.description: Per started minute of output audio/video, GIF, stream-copied video and video re-encoded at 720p or lower (not charged for thumbnails).

video-reencode-minute.title: HD video re-encode minute
video-reencode-minute.description: Per started minute of output when mp4/webm video is actually re-encoded above 720p (1080p-class, after the 1080p cap). Charged instead of media-minute, never in addition. Failed files are free.
